references.text: The Lord promised to lead the Israelites to a land flowing with milk and honey, the same promise confirmed in Deuteronomy 26:3.
God's promise to Abraham to give the land to his descendants, which the Israelites declare they have received.
God's promise to Isaac to give the land to his descendants, part of the oath to the fathers.
God's promise to Jacob to give him and his descendants the land, fulfilled when they enter the promised land.
Instructions to go to the priest serving in those days, the same wording as in Deuteronomy 26:3.
Reference to the priests serving in those days, parallel to the priest's role in the firstfruits ritual.
Law of the firstfruits that were to be brought to the priest, the background for the ritual described in Deuteronomy 26.
Abraham lived in the promised land as a foreigner, trusting in God's promise which the Israelites confess they have received.
